notes: P4: Home's billboard art + the sliding column (10d-spec §2-5). Rotation (9 s) is frozen; the hero shows pick 0 at launch.
scrolled: DOWN from Play -> atTop 1->0 over 280 ms, ty -> -(rowY[0] - 27), the art fades with the column (artFade = f(ty)).
first-slide: RIGHT on the last hero button (Details, index 1) turns the slide (swap 280 ms); a 15 s hold follows — irrelevant while frozen.

mute-pill: the Unmute/Mute small Btn exists only while a trailer plays; needs freeze on,trailer and the instance's fixture HLS (/fixture/trailer.m3u8) with TrailerFrame paused at t=0. The trailer surface is a TextureView whose decoded frame may differ by a level between runs: declared as a dither region (reported), not masked.
Window px = dp x 2 (1920x1080 over a 960x540 canvas).
